pyongyang-2016.notes: Source 2 is a bare image with no title or header; it is not possible to read from it which contest it shows (the address and capture date, shortly after the contest day, are the only link). Colour meaning and the last column were not decoded; Korean text unread (tesseract has no Korean model). Row count 41 comes from row layout; the rank column appears to end at 36, so ties may be involved.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw no per-problem columns and called it standings; the image shows 12 columns of coloured cells holding numbers beside each team.
sources.evidence: The image has 41 team rows and 12 problem columns of green, red and empty cells carrying numbers, followed by a column of numbers, so it is a per-problem board and not only standings.
